subject.title: fix(agents): pass attemptNumber instead of apiKeyIndex to retry callbacks (#102938)

question: Should the public plugin SDK's existing `attempt` callback field remain supported without a deprecation marker, or should OpenClaw begin a documented removal lifecycle now?
rationale: The code can add the explicit fields mechanically, but only maintainers can define whether an already-shipped plugin API should be discouraged or removed in a future release.

options.title: Keep `attempt` supported
options.body: Remove `@deprecated`, add the two explicit fields, and defer any lifecycle change until a separately approved compatibility plan exists.

options.title: Approve a deprecation lifecycle
options.body: Retain the marker only with an explicit removal target, plugin migration documentation, and compatibility tests covering existing consumers.

recommendation.title: Keep `attempt` supported
recommendation.body: Remove `@deprecated`, add the two explicit fields, and defer any lifecycle change until a separately approved compatibility plan exists.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a permanent public plugin SDK contract decision rather than only a local retry-loop implementation detail.
